messages:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] P1 detected: backend-token-service 5xx spike in eu-west-1 — avg error rate 18% over 2m, paging oncall rotation. Incident ID: INC-2026-2389
Priya K.: jumping in, grabbing driver. opening bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/INC-2026-2389 
Jamal: thx — i'm taking comms for the handoff. Priya, are you primary right now or do you want to pass?
Priya K.: I'm mid-shift but stepping out in ~10m. can take driver for first 10 unless someone swaps. primary -> Priya, secondary -> Jamal (comms).
Eve: I'm inbound as overlap for next shift in 8m, can pick up driver if needed.
Nate: quick note — customers with long-lived KV cache may see elevated errors (we're returning 502 from token refresh). runbook says check key rotations and redis-cluster health.
Priya K.: good call. first check: service logs + redis metrics. tagging runbook snippet: 
```
Step 1: curl -sS https://meta.redwood/internal/health/token-service | jq .
Step 2: kubectl -n prod logs deploy/token-service -c api --since=5m | grep -i 502
Step 3: check /metrics -> token_refresh_failures_total > 10/m = escalated
```
Jamal: I'm posting customer-impact note to #incidents-updates after we confirm scope. Priya, please confirm which customer segments affected (all regions or eu-west-1 only).
Priya K.: initial metric shows spike only in eu-west-1. setting scope -> EU region customers (approx 12% of active sessions).
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2389 updated: scope set to eu-west-1, severity P1, pagers notified.
Rosa: FYI, I just saw autoscaler churn around the same time. could be a noisy deploy at 02:10UTC? deploy-bot reported token-service v2.3.7 at 02:08UTC.
Priya K.: can someone check deploys? `kubectl rollout status deploy/token-service` and rollback if health failing.
Eve: checking rollout now. `kubectl get rs -n prod | grep token-service` -> new RS failing >50% pods CrashLoopBackOff.
Nate: rolling back approved. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/token-service -n prod` — initiating.
Priya K.: Jamal, start customer comms draft: short note + ETA; mark as "investigating, rollback in progress, mitigation underway". include support link and status page.
Jamal: draft -> "We're investigating elevated auth errors in eu-west-1. A rollback is in progress. We'll post updates in 15 minutes or after next milestone." posting to #incidents-updates now. :loud_sound:
oncall-bot: Action recorded: rollout undo initiated by Nate. Watchers: eng-oncall, eng-runtime.
Priya K.: monitoring metrics. token_refresh_failures_total dropping from 18% -> 6% in last 2m. good sign.
Eve: pods stabilizing, new pod count converging to desired. no new 502s in logs for 3m.
Priya K.: excellent. Eve, if you can stay as driver when I step off in 6m, that'd be perfect. Jamal will continue comms.
Eve: I can take driver. I'll post a quick handoff summary when Priya leaves.
Priya K.: handoff plan: 
- driver: Eve (takes bridge, continues triage)
- comms: Jamal (updates customers + status page)
- secondary/backup: Nate (infra rollback/metrics)
- notes: rollback applied, metrics improving; watch for recurrence in next 30m.
Jamal: acknowledged. adding runbook pointers + escalation path to update: /runbooks/token-service-ops.md (section 4.2).
Rosa: leaving a note for the morning shift: check for related deploys in other regions; ensure no planned v2.3.7 rollouts pending.
Priya K.: signing off now — Eve taking driver. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Eve: taking over bridge. I'll annotate the incident timeline and close when stable.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2389: status -> mitigated (partial) — error rate reduced below threshold in eu-west-1. Monitoring for 30m grace period.
Jamal: final comms posted to customers: "Issue mitigated in eu-west-1; rollback applied; monitoring. Contact support if you still see errors"
Eve: leaving final note for handover: watch token_refresh_failures_total and deploy events; if spike reappears escalate to oncall-manager.
Nate: acknowledged, I'll hold the pager if needed.
Eve: closing thread in 30m if stable. thanks all.
